review_notes: I read the whole file and checked it against Mathlib's LinearAlgebra tree and the sibling stable-range library. The only candidate concepts were parityEquiv, x₀/x₁/y₀/y₁, row/rightWitness, rectangularRow/rectangularColumn and kernelEquiv. parityEquiv is a thin composition of Finsupp.domLCongr, Equiv.natSumNatEquivNat and Finsupp.sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp. It is a named specialisation with its own coordinate API (the parityEquiv_*_apply lemmas), and I found no competing Mathlib definition of it. The row and matrix definitions are example-specific data. Bass.IsRightUnimodular and the kernel equivalence come from the sibling library StableRange.RightRowCompletion, and I found no Mathlib counterpart. The file reuses Mathlib's dotProductBilin, InvariantBasisNumber, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup and Module.End rather than redefining them. I found no independent duplicate concept that would justify consolidation. My search for a Mathlib counterpart was targeted, not exhaustive, so some uncertainty remains.
